value: Lies up at the waterline by day and hauls out on the bank below the shelf at night.
Sits in the deep end of the seep where the diggers have stopped working.
Lies in the great room among the bones and rises when anyone comes close.
Feeds at the edge of the seep on what the plasm leaves.
Clings to the wet stones below the lip of the seep.
Drifts in the shallows where the seep runs out.
Curls in the dark under the broken lintel.
Lies in the flooded deep room of the temple and strips whatever falls into it.
Dozes under the awning by the hatchery for the warmth.
Grazes the bank by the hatchery and wanders back at dusk.
Noses at the hatchery lids until a keeper shoos it away.
Lies up in the den among the dragged-in remains, with stolen tools in the bedding.
Waits in the bone scatter at the mouth.
Clings to a skull at the edge of the scatter.
Hangs on the dry grass above the bones.
